noir-shell-cropped.name: NOIR SHELL Cropped Puffer
description: The icon of the CORSO winter wardrobe in a cropped version. Flawless technology, where every detail is an example of premium design.
Two readings: a striking GLOSSY with a patent-leather shine and a restrained MATTE BLACK with a deep matte texture.
details: Innovative eco-down — a weightless hypoallergenic filling
Sculptural stand-up collar that protects from the wind
Drawcords with stoppers at the hem and Velcro cuffs with elastic inserts

noir-shell.name: NOIR SHELL Puffer
description: NOIR SHELL is the icon of the CORSO winter wardrobe. Architectural volume, a monumental stand-up collar and technology that looks like part of a fashion concept.
details: Innovative eco-down — a weightless hypoallergenic filling
Drawcords with stoppers and Velcro cuffs

noir-shell-midi.name: NOIR SHELL MIDI Puffer
description: The long version of NOIR SHELL — the same technology and sculptural collar, in a midi length for the coldest days.

puhovyk-corso.name: CORSO Puffer
description: The legendary CORSO puffer with a patent shine. Light as a cloud and keeps its shape season after season.
details: Filling: high-tech eco-down — does not clump when washed and keeps its volume perfectly

palto-cashmere.name: Double-Breasted Maxi Coat
description: Premium Italian YSL fabric — a blend of natural warmth, exceptional softness and a noble texture.

An architectural maxi silhouette in a deep graphite shade. Bold lapels, a double-breasted fastening and statement epaulettes let you change the mood of the coat — from striking classic to restrained minimalism.

palto-pure-wool.name: PURE WOOL Maxi Coat
description: A maxi coat in a deep graphite shade. Dense Italian wool creates a strong silhouette and keeps you comfortable in the cool season.
Deep graphite — a timeless classic with character that adds quiet luxury to any look.
details: Soft lining, pleasant to the touch

palto-grey.name: Straight-Cut Grey Coat
description: A new coat in a refined grey shade. A straight silhouette, double-breasted fastening and epaulettes — a staple that works with denim, knitwear and tailored trousers.

palto-deep-blue.name: DEEP BLUE Coat
description: A coat in deep blue — the outer layer of the CORSO MATCH capsule. Works on its own or with the insulated anorak set and the striped shirt for a layered total look.

trench-coat.name: Midi Trench Coat
description: The kind of piece you see once and fall in love with forever. Premium Italian fabric and the perfect midi length.
A staple with a long story ahead — in three colours: sky blue, light beige and black.

parka-corso.name: Oversized Parka
description: Architectural volume meets premium Burberry cotton. Functional pockets, a stand-up collar and an adjustable waist — details that make the parka a strong part of the autumn capsule.
Easy to style with classic jeans, knitwear, white denim or more feminine pieces.

bomber-corso.name: CORSO Bomber
description: The cult CORSO bomber — the absolute leader of your wish lists. Voluminous sleeves and a dense fabric that feels flawless to the touch.

bomber-grey.name: Long Insulated Bomber
description: A long grey bomber with insulation and a hood — keeps you comfortable even at temperatures down to −5 °C.

set-anorak-winter.name: Insulated Anorak Set
description: The winter take on function in the CORSO collection. Incredibly soft cotton, pleasant to the body, with warm sheared fleece inside.
A sharp shoulder line, sculptural cut and delicate gold hardware create a complete look where every considered detail becomes a synonym for modern luxury.
details: Zip-up anorak with a stand-up collar

set-navy-bomber-skirt.name: Bomber + Midi Skirt Set
description: A set of a voluminous bomber and a fitted midi skirt in refined Italian 100% cotton. For when you want to step beyond the usual.
Deep Navy — the new colour of the collection as an alternative to classic black: restrained and striking at once.
details: Fitted midi skirt with a slit

kostium-lampas.name: Double-Stripe Tracksuit
description: The cult CORSO sets: an oversized track jacket with a stand-up collar and palazzo trousers with a double waistband — a set that never gets lost in the crowd.
Adjustable volume at the hem: toggles let you wear the trousers as palazzos or as joggers.
details: Track jacket with a mesh lining
Quality hardware and a premium zip
Adjustable toggles at the trouser hem

set-denim-blue.name: Track Jacket + Skort Set
description: A feminine, light set considered down to the details, in trending DENIM BLUE with a fine side stripe.
Instead of a regular skirt — a skort: it looks elegant yet lets you move freely. Build your set: track jacket + palazzos or track jacket + skort.

set-zip-italian-knit.name: Zip Jacket + Palazzo Set
description: A zip jacket with palazzos or joggers — your choice. One basic set, different vibes. Style it your way, wear it your way.
Premium Italian knit quality.

leather-jacket.name: Structured Leather Jacket
description: A refined play of shape and silhouette: voluminous shoulders contrast smoothly with a fitted waist, creating a striking sculptural line.
The high collar adds drama. Finish the look with a matching mini or midi skirt for a complete monochrome set.

leather-skirt.name: Leather Skirt
description: A skirt from the CORSO leather line — mini or midi, depending on your mood. Build a full leather set or choose each piece separately.
details: Pairs with the jacket and bomber of the line

leather-bomber-set.name: Leather Bomber + Skirt Set
description: A play on contrast, delicacy and volume. A refined midi skirt that softly follows the lines, and an oversized bomber in soft premium eco-leather.
A set that highlights a flawless silhouette and carries an aristocratic vibe.

sorochka-vuzol.name: Knot Shirt
description: A shirt where a precise cut meets feminine aesthetics. A piece created beyond seasons.
An architectural shoulder line, a delicately shaped knot at the waist with beautiful draping, a refined stand-up collar and long cuffs with statement hardware.

sorochka-vidkryta-spyna.name: Open-Back Shirt
description: A shirt where a basic meets character. Statement shoulders — a manifesto of strength, clean lines and a silhouette that stands out instantly.
A half-open back — the fine line between restraint and hidden magnetism. Wear it with denim, relaxed trousers or leather.

sorochka-dvosharova.name: Two-Layer Insulated Shirt
description: An oversized two-layer shirt for those who love quality you can feel. The outer layer is the cult fabric of the house of Gucci, the lining is pure cotton.
It counts as outerwear: wear it instead of a jacket on cool days or over a basic look.

suknia-sorochka.name: Shirt Dress
description: A shirt dress that looks new every time. With jeans — as a light trench, with leggings — as a dress, with wide trousers — for layering.
details: Wear as a dress or a light trench

lehinsy-shtrypky.name: Stirrup Leggings
description: That subtle yet decisive touch that instantly pulls a look into refined sartorial. The perfect pair for a parka, trench or jacket.
details: Dense matte sport spandex — 100% opaque on the body
Maximum stretch that never restricts movement
Mid rise that flatters the legs

longsliv-corso.name: CORSO Long Sleeve
description: An essential basic for cool weather. Goes with any bottoms — zero stress at the wardrobe and a flawless look.
details: Goes under any outer layer and with any bottoms

longsliv-lion.name: Textured Linen-Blend Long Sleeve
description: A textured long sleeve with added linen — fine, semi-sheer, with a noble texture. Wear it on its own or as a second layer.

longsliv-vovna.name: 100% Wool Long Sleeve
description: A grey long sleeve in 100% wool — a warm basic that works with the whole wardrobe.
details: A warm basic for the cold season

manishka.name: Knit Dickey
description: What only yesterday seemed a practical detail is today one of the most interesting accessories of the cold season. Wear it under a coat, trench or jacket.

set-satin.name: Satin Top + Palazzo Set
description: The bestseller of the CORSO summer collection. Noble lines and a dense weave that makes the fabric opaque and resistant to damage.
Perfect both for a special evening and for a refined daytime look.

satin-shorts-lace.name: Satin Shorts with Lace
description: The very shorts from your saved Pinterest pins. The milky shade of premium satin highlights a tan, and the lace trim adds French chic.

set-tencel.name: Tencel Set
description: An oversized shirt and palazzos in weightless tencel. A relaxed silhouette and a noble, barely visible texture that plays softly in the sun.

set-tencel-bando.name: Bandeau Top + Harem Pants Set
description: Airy volume, snow-white colour and lightness — tencel that seems made of sunlight and warm wind.
details: Harem pants with an elastic drawstring waist
Pockets and ties at the hem

set-linen.name: Linen Shirt + Shorts Set
description: A collection of linen sets in natural linen, in the juicy and basic colours of the season. Sometimes the right colour sets the mood for the whole day.

sorochka-poppy.name: Sheer Linen Shirt
description: A shirt in semi-sheer linen in a stunning poppy red shade — instantly makes any street-style look the centre of attention.

set-polo-skirt.name: Polo + Skirt Set
description: A polo and a voluminous two-layer lined skirt that adds that effortless volume. The perfect balance of proportions.

set-jacket-shorts.name: Jacket + Shorts Set
description: A light, breathable cotton set: a jacket with an on-trend stand-up collar and high-waisted shorts.

sorochka-smuzhka.name: Striped Shirt with Lace
description: A lace trim — a signature CORSO detail that makes you stand out.

suknia-lion.name: Knitted Linen Maxi Dress
description: A dress in Italian knitted linen that softly wraps the figure, flows with every movement and lets the body breathe.
An open back, adjustable fit at the back and maxi length create a silhouette that looks expensive without extra details.

set-satin-trio.name: Satin Three-Piece Set
description: A shirt jacket, top and shorts in a restrained total black. The noble shine and fresh feel of smooth satin turn a basic concept into pure pleasure.
